title: 第1352章 七路灯气第1351章 换灯芯
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
九叔问：“还到哪里？”
林凡道：“回魂桥丹灯。”
顾安纸匣也接入。
他的声音很低。
“继续。”
林凡道：“青丹主的丹影根，在回魂桥。”
“但他不能直接补。”
“所以他用外灯收东西。”
“空灯收命。”
“封口灯收声。”
“还有五盏，可能分别收影、名、恩、罪、身，或者别的。”
“七路灯气，最后还一。”
“回到丹灯。”
堂屋里彻底安静。
文才听得脸色发白。
“也就是说，空灯就算没成，其他灯也可能还在收？”
林凡点头。
“对。”
“空灯失败，只是七路之一失败。”
“封口灯还没破干净。”

秋生皱眉。
“那四号地那边很重要。”
“对。”
林凡道。
“四号地不是残点。”
“是第二灯路。”
顾安声音缓缓响起。
“我也是这个判断。”
掌门沉声道：“第二灯路？”
林凡道：“暂称二号灯路。”
“不要叫真名。”
九叔点头。
“继续用代号。”
林凡道：“如果七灯还一成立。”
“那还有五个地方。”
“纸眼包袱里的地名，可能就是路线。”
掌门问：“你觉得哪些？”
林凡没有立刻说。
他看向纸眼包袱拓录。
黑水集已经对应二号灯路。

其余地名还有双柳村、七里铺、老鸦渡。
任家镇、白水镇、石桥村、乱石坡也在其中。
content_en:
Uncle Jiu asked: "Where else are you going?"
Lin Fan said: "Huihun Bridge Dan Lamp."
Gu An's paper box is also connected.
His voice was low.
"Continue."
Lin Fan said: "The alchemy root of Lord Qing Dan is at Huihun Bridge."
"But he can't just make it up."
"So he used an outside light to collect his stuff."
"The light is empty and you accept your life."
"Seal the light and turn off the sound."
"There are also five lamps, which may contain shadow, name, grace, sin, body, or something else."
"Seven lights, one in the end."
"Go back to Dan Deng."
The hall was completely quiet.
Wen Cai's face turned pale upon hearing this.
"In other words, even if the empty lamp fails, the other lamps may still be closed?"
Lin Fan nodded.
"Yes."
"The failure of the empty lamp is just the failure of one of the seven ways."
"The sealing lamp hasn't been completely broken yet."
Qiu Sheng frowned.
"That side of No. 4 is very important."
"Yes."
Lin Fan said.
"Land No. 4 is not a residual point."
"It's the second light road."
Gu An's voice sounded slowly.
"That's my judgment too."
The leader said solemnly: "The second light road?"
Lin Fan said: "It is temporarily called Light Road No. 2."
"Don't call me by your real name."
Uncle Jiu nodded.
"Keep using code names."
Lin Fan said: "If the Seven Lanterns are still established."
"That leaves five places."
"The place names in the paper bag may be the route."
The leader asked: "Which ones do you think?"
Lin Fan didn't say anything immediately.
He looked at Zhiyan Baotuolu.
Black Water Collection already corresponds to Light Road No. 2.
Other place names include Shuangliu Village, Qilipu and Laoyadu.
Renjia Town, Baishui Town, Shiqiao Village and Luanshipo are also among them.
